card.name: Small words in King David passages
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, over, up, the, his) and spaces right after king or monarchy in texts about King David and ancient Israel or Judah. Also verse-number gaps in Bible citations.

modes.label: Linking word after king
modes.description: A short word such as of or over following king, ruler or kingship in David or Judah history.
modes.example: Eph. 4:31-32). At Saul’s death the tribe of Judah, to whom David belonged, elected him as king<< of>> Judah and placed him on the throne

modes.label: Gap before numbers
modes.description: A blank or digit right after a Bible reference or the Judean Monarchy, just before a number.
